t: This is the Wellington Arch, a Grade I listed triumphal arch at the heart of Hyde Park Corner. It's also known as the Constitution Arch, and originally as the Green Park Arch. It stands on a large green traffic island, with crossings for pedestrians. A ceremonial route between Hyde Park and Constitution Hill still passes under it and can be used for official processions. The arch was designed by Decimus Burton, one of the foremost English architects of the nineteenth century, a master of Greek and Roman Revival, and Georgian neoclassical styles.
